description.value: A dry-camping lake site within the fee-based West Harrison recreation system on the west shore of Harrison Lake; family-oriented and pet-friendly, but specific amenities for Wood Lake itself are not detailed in the available page text.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Wood Lake Campground as one of six campgrounds operated by Sts'ailes First Nation via the West Harrison Reservations and Camping website. The website confirms active operations (May 2026 notices re: campfire bans and reopenings) and lists Wood Lake Campground explicitly among its locations. The website states 'dry camping only' across all sites and features a full online reservations system; no phone, address, or cycling-specific amenity details are found in the fetched content.
concerns: No physical address in OSM record or on the website for the specific Wood Lake Campground location.
No phone number present in OSM or found on the website.
The fetched website content did not include the specific Wood Lake Campground subpage, so campground-specific amenity details (site count, facilities) could not be verified.
Website covers six campgrounds under one domain; Wood Lake-specific amenity information is limited.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operated campground on Harrison Lake run by Sts'ailes First Nation with online reservations, suitable as a destination for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website explicitly states 'dry camping only' across all campgrounds in this network, which suggests no electrical hookups; however, absence of explicit mention of charging stations means device/e-bike charging remain null rather than false.
